seo.title: HubSpot AI chatbot for lead capture | Steps AI
seo.description: Connect HubSpot to Steps AI so leads from WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website are saved to HubSpot with the details collected in the chat.

hero.title: Send every new lead from the chat to HubSpot.
hero.body: Your agent answers questions, asks for the details your team needs and saves the lead to HubSpot. Sales picks it up in the CRM they already use.
hero.reassurance: Leads saved where your team works. The fields you choose. Your sales process stays the same.

lines.text: We have 12 stores. Can your plan cover all of them?
Yes. Could I take your name and work email so our team can share the right plan?
Thanks Rahul. Our team will be in touch today.

useCases.title: What you can do with HubSpot connected.
useCases.intro: If you already have a CRM, keep it. If you do not, the Steps AI CRM is built in.

items.title: Create contacts from conversations
items.body: When a visitor shares their details, the agent saves them to HubSpot instead of leaving them in a chat log.

items.title: Ask for the details your team needs
items.body: Collect name, email, company and job title, plus custom fields you define, before the lead is saved.

items.title: Capture leads on every channel
items.body: Leads from WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website all end up in the same place.

items.title: Follow up on shoppers who did not buy
items.body: A customer who is not ready yet is saved, so your team can follow up later.

walkthrough.title: From a first question to a lead in HubSpot.
walkthrough.intro: A sales enquiry on your website.

steps.label: Answer the question
steps.customer: Do you work with multi-store brands?
steps.agent: Yes. One workspace can run separate agents for each store.
steps.note: The agent answers from your own information first.

steps.label: Ask for details
steps.customer: Interesting. What would it cost for 12 stores?
steps.agent: Our team can put that together. May I have your name, work email and company?
steps.note: Only the fields you set up are asked for.

steps.label: Save to HubSpot
steps.agent: Thank you Rahul. Our team will be in touch today.
steps.note: The contact is created in HubSpot with what was collected.

setup.title: Connect HubSpot in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect HubSpot
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose HubSpot. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds HubSpot to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Add the customer creation skill
items.body: Switch on the skill that creates a customer record, choose HubSpot and pick the fields to collect.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: The agent saves what the customer shares in the chat. It does not identify anonymous visitors.
You can use HubSpot, the built-in Steps AI CRM, or both.

items.q: Do I need HubSpot to capture leads?
items.a: No. Steps AI has a built-in CRM for customers, tickets and live requests. Connect HubSpot if your team already works there.
The ones you choose: name, email, company, job title and any custom fields you add.

items.q: Does it work on WhatsApp and Instagram too?
items.a: Yes. Leads from every connected channel can be saved to HubSpot.

cta.title: See Steps AI work with HubSpot.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through a real conversation using HubSpot and your own information.
